review:
Blood & Shadow is a 5x4 gothic tumbling slot. Winning combinations are destroyed and the remaining symbols drop, while a Ritual Bar under the reels counts destroyed symbols toward bonus levels. Each new level awards +2 Candle Spins, with +6 more for reaching Cursed Spins.

Sticky wilds land on reels 2 to 5 and, in the bonus, drop to the bottom and stay until they join a win. xSplit only appears in Cursed Spins. Nolimit rates it Medium volatility, unusual for the studio, with a 6,666x cap. A good first Nolimit game.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
